desc: Minecraft-style title box with a gold border, no lower captions. a: over the boss's shoulder, the camera pans onto the tiny boy holding the book up, him in the middle of the frame (softer light on his face). b (cut on 'Formula'): side on, he rises on his toes; the boss leans down and reaches for the book.
Dennis takes the book and writes in it; the boy watches on tiptoe.
Insert: the page. 'Phone me in 9 years' appears word by word as it's spoken, then a made-up signature. No captions.
Home, night: the dad at the table with the bills and a nearly empty coin jar rubs his eyes with the heel of his hand; the boy watches from the doorway.
The shed: the fifth-hand club kart up on a kart stand under the bare bulb (storyboard framing).
a: the dad kneels at the rear wheel and tightens the nut with a spanner, pull after pull. b: the same kart fixed up like new; he stands back.

Split screen, the dad's jobs: office desk (9:00); hammering in a FOR SALE board's post with a claw hammer, rigid in his right hand, strike after strike (18:00); scrubbing a plate under the running tap at a restaurant sink (23:00).
The kart track paddock: kids by their karts, which face them (bigger, cadet-size library karts). He's the only Black kid.
The kids and parents, facing him at first, turn away one by one and slowly walk off into the paddock. He stands completely still, helmet in hand. The camera holds.

Behind a van, his dad over by the far end facing away. Head down, a glance at his dad, eyes shut as he holds his breath; then he turns his face away, wipes the corner of his eye once, breathes and straightens up as if he is fine.
His dad kneels at his side, turned toward us, talking, his hand on the boy's shoulder; on 'track' he points at the circuit. The kart is parked well back.
Wide: visor down, the karts launch and he takes the inside line. The wheels roll.
Wide: his kart crosses the line under the chequered flag.
'And again': he lifts a trophy on the top step.
'And again': a shelf crowded with trophies, the red book among them.
In the boss's office he signs the contract, his dad behind him; then he and the boss shake hands at arm's length, looking at each other.
Brazil 2008, last lap in the rain: his silver car closes on a slower white car, a car's width apart. Fuller Interlagos: stands both sides, boards, light poles, towers, footbridge, city.
Two corners from the end: up the inside, side by side, and through.
Across the line under the chequered flag; his crew in the garage erupt.
Dennis on the pit wall: a slow breath, then a clenched fist pumped in front of his chest.
Callback: the fixed-up kart on its stand and the autograph book pinned open on the wall beside it, both whole in frame.
The grown driver lifts his helmet off on 'Lewis'; on 'Hamilton' it fades into a real photo of him in November 2008 (CC BY 2.0, Alistair Rickman), held, then cut.
